look_here_first: Look for low spring violets with heart-shaped leaves and blue-purple five-petaled irregular flowers; inspect spur shape, petal hairs, leaf pubescence and calyx to separate similar violets.
photo_note: One attributed provisional species-recognition photograph; detailed diagnostic anatomy, synonym concepts and county-native screening incomplete.
identification_caution: Viola species and subspecies can be hard to distinguish; source from Wisconsin, verify local taxonomy before final visual ID.
